ir.name: advantage_logsigmoid_scaled_delta_regret_norm_margin_pairwise_v1
ir.intuition: Repaired novelty failure by switching normalization from norm of delta_rank to norm of delta_regret, which is a distinct signal reducing similarity to prior designs. Margin is computed as sigmoid of mean advantage_gap clamped between 0 and 4 for positive scaling, replacing tanh for asymmetric margin emphasizing positive advantage. This margin scales normalized log_prob difference divided by mean norm(delta_regret) + epsilon. This changes margin shape and normalization basis, preserving stability and dynamic scaling while reducing similarity and improving novelty.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon = 1e-6
mean_adv = mean(advantage_gap)
clamped_mean_adv = clamp(mean_adv, 0, 4)
margin = sigmoid(clamped_mean_adv)
norm_per_sample = norm(delta_regret)
norm = max(mean(norm_per_sample), epsilon)
x_raw = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm
x = margin * x_raw
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
loss_weighted = loss * weight
loss_mean = sum(loss_weighted) / max(sum(weight), epsilon)
return loss_mean
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    mean_adv = ops.mean(advantage_gap)
    clamped_mean_adv = ops.clamp(mean_adv, 0.0, 4.0)
    margin = ops.sigmoid(clamped_mean_adv)
    norm_per_sample = ops.norm(delta_regret)
    norm = ops.maximum(ops.mean(norm_per_sample), epsilon)
    x_raw = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm)
    x = ops.mul(margin, x_raw)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_weighted), ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon))
    return loss_mean
